PRODUCT DESCRIPTION:
3 Layers & 3 Pair of Shoes: The 3 layers design can separate your shoes and well protect them from scratching or rubbing. travel shoe bag is designed with lots of thoughtful details, including a carrying handle, double zipper for easy-open, net structure to keep shoe breathing. It’s also a suitable size for luggage case, which you can put it inside or hung it up on pull rod.

It can also be used as makeup bag, toiletries bag, clothes package and for other uses. There is a back pocket for cell phone as well.
Multi usage: This shoe bag is not only ideal to store your shoes but also ideal to be used as a toiletry bag, clothes package, make up bag, and for many other multipurpose capabilities. Add this waterproof polyester footwear storage bag to your collection for a complete organized getaway.
